preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= n1 for line in stdin_lines[1:]) and all(1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= n2 for line in stdin_lines[1:])
preconditions.description: Every edge in the input connects a valid vertex in U (1..n1) to a valid vertex in V (1..n2).

preconditions.expression: len(stdin_lines) == m + 1 and all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdin_lines[1:])
preconditions.description: The input has exactly m+1 lines: the first line contains n1, n2, m, and each of the next m lines contains exactly two integers representing an edge.

preconditions.expression: n1 >= 1 and n2 >= 1 and m >= 0 and n1 <= 2000 and n2 <= 2000 and m <= 2000
preconditions.description: The input dimensions satisfy 1 ≤ n1, n2 ≤ 2000 and 0 ≤ m ≤ 2000.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 1 + cntk for line in stdout_lines) and all(int(stdout_lines[k].split()[0]) == cntk for k in range(1, minDegree + 1))
postconditions.description: For each k from 1 to minDegree, the k-th output line starts with cntk (the size of the minimal k-covering), followed by cntk distinct edge indices (1-based, original order).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(edge_idx) <= m for edge_idx in ' '.join(stdout_lines[k].split()[1:]).split()) for k in range(1, minDegree + 1))
postconditions.description: All edge indices in the output are valid (1 ≤ edge index ≤ m).
If minDegree is 0, the first output line is '0' (no edges needed). Otherwise, the first output line corresponds to k=1.

postconditions.expression: all(any(edge_idx in ' '.join(stdout_lines[k].split()[1:]).split() for edge_idx in ' '.join(stdout_lines[k+1].split()[1:]).split()) for k in range(1, minDegree))
postconditions.description: For each k, the minimal (k+1)-covering includes all edges of the minimal k-covering (monotonicity).

postconditions.expression: (lambda k: all(sum(1 for edge in edges if edge[0] == u or edge[1] == v) >= k for u in range(1, n1 + 1) for v in range(1, n2 + 1)))(' '.join(stdout_lines[k].split()[1:]).split())
postconditions.description: For each k, the edges in the k-th output line form a k-covering: every vertex in U and V is incident to at least k edges in the subset.

postconditions.expression: all(not any(edge_idx in ' '.join(stdout_lines[k].split()[1:]).split() for edge_idx in ' '.join(stdout_lines[k].split()[1:]).split()[i+1:]) for k in range(1, minDegree + 1) for i in range(len(' '.join(stdout_lines[k].split()[1:]).split()) - 1))
postconditions.description: For each k, the edge indices in the k-th output line are pairwise distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(len(' '.join(stdout_lines[k].split()[1:]).split()) == min(cntk for cntk in range(0, m + 1) if (lambda edges: all(sum(1 for edge in edges if edge[0] == u or edge[1] == v) >= k for u in range(1, n1 + 1) for v in range(1, n2 + 1)))([edges[i-1] for i in edges if i in ' '.join(stdout_lines[k].split()[1:]).split()])) for k in range(1, minDegree + 1))
postconditions.description: For each k, the size of the k-covering in the k-th output line is minimal possible.
